verdicts.ar: لم يسمع ابن أبي بردة من ابن عمر شيئا، إنما يروي عن أبيه عنه، وروايته عن جده منقطعة لم يسمع منه شيئا
verdicts.en: Ibn Abi Burdah heard nothing from Ibn Umar; he narrates only from his father from him. And his narration from his grandfather is disconnected: he heard nothing from him.

flags.label: 'From his grandfather' means through his father
flags.detail: In Bukhari 6022 the chain reads 'Sa'id ibn Abi Burdah ibn Abi Musa, from his father, from his grandfather'. The grandfather is Sa'id's grandfather Abu Musa (Ibn Hajar: 'that is, Ibn Abi Musa al-Ash'ari, stated explicitly in Abu Awanah's Sahih'), and Sa'id did not hear from him directly (Ibn Abi Hatim), so the pronoun chain is read as son from father from grandfather, each link one generation.

bio: Grandson of the Companion Abu Musa al-Ash'ari and son of Abu Burdah, the judge of Kufa; a Kufan Successor of the fifth generation whom Ahmad, Ibn Ma'in, al-Ijli, Abu Hatim and al-Nasa'i all call reliable. He transmits his grandfather's hadith through his father; Ibn Abi Hatim records that he heard nothing from Abu Musa or from Ibn Umar directly. Shu'bah, Qatadah and Mis'ar are among those who narrate from him. His death year is uncertain: 168 as copied by Mughultay, which Ibn Hajar suspects should read 138.
